history.period: 21st century - construction reported to have started in 2011 (per visitor reviews - verify)
history.summary: The Surya Temple at Purulia town, on East Lake Road by the side of the Saheb Bandh lake, maintained by the Chhath Puja committee; Chhath Puja is the main annual occasion here. Identity is confirmed by multiple place listings, but HISTORY FLAG: one visitor review says construction started in 2011 and the temple is now 'full complete', while other reviews call it 'one of the oldest surya temple in purulia town' - conflicting claims, verify. Another review claims it is a copy of a South Indian sun temple, 'this is 2nd' (verify). No founder or inauguration date found in any published source. COORDINATES from the map geocoder for 'Surya Temple, Saheb Bandh Road' - street-level, plausible (verify).

name: Surya Temple (Saheb Bandh, Purulia)
town_description: Purulia is a city in western West Bengal and the district headquarters of Purulia district, on the Chota Nagpur plateau. It is known for the Saheb Bandh lake, ancient stone deuls (Banda, Deulghata, Pakbirra Jain temples in the surrounding district), and Chhau dance.

travel.airport: Birsa Munda Airport, Ranchi, about 105-115 km (verify)
travel.railway: Purulia Junction (PRR), about 2-3 km from the temple (verify)
travel.road: East Lake Road, beside Saheb Bandh lake in Purulia town; Hotel Akash Sarovar and the science museum are nearby landmarks

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Chhath Puja (October/November) is the major festival
